craft_notes: Sthāyin: nāda-vīra of heard doings resolving to jaya-śānta of conquering close — the treatise ends in blessing (end-prosperity). Each-to-each handed; bookish-strait-narrow kept piled (narrowing enacted). Rejected: (a) trimming pile → killed: pile IS the strait. Read aloud: BY-these, EACH-to-EACH … THEN-book-ISH, SUN-dry, STRAIT, NARR-ow.

lines: By these, each-to-each, knowing handed — self —
that common use — then bookish, sundry, strait, narrow.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ābhiḥ parasparaṃ jñānasaṃkrāntyātmā sa laukikaḥ vyavahāro 'tha śāstrīyo nānāsaṃkocasaṃkaṭaḥ
